# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A shop prints a QR code on each receipt so customers can leave a review. Mira's someday idea: not this release or soon; no scheduled release.
